results.llm_raw: {"say":"Install cutters with trash on both miner runs feeding L3 so the hub receives the required left-half shapes.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B97","B90","B81"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"Cut the first L3 input run and discard the right half, leaving RuRu---- to continue to L3."},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B98","B91","B82"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"Cut the second L3 input run the same way so L3 only merges identical halves."}]}

{"say":"Insert rotater+cutter+trash on both L3 input chains to convert full shapes into the required top-half shape.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B97","B90","B81"]},"building":[{"kind":"rotater"},{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"Cut and discard the unwanted half on the M3 feed so L3 receives the top half."},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B91","B82","B70"]},"building":[{"kind":"rotater"},{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"Apply the same half-shape conversion to the other L3 input chain."}]}

{"say":"Refreshing belt topology on the main miner runs, cutter connections, and hub input belts to restore flow of the cut half-shape.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B112","B105","B97","B90","B81","B69","B63"]},"building":"belt"},"why":"fix empty run from miner M3 to balancer L3"},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B106","B98","B91","B82","B70","B64"]},"building":"belt"},"why":"fix empty run from second miner to balancer L3"},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B100","B84","B85"]},"building":"belt"},"why":"refresh cutter input/output belt topology"},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B135","B136","B137"]},"building":"belt"},"why":"refresh hub input belts so they accept delivered shape"}]}

{"say":"Turn the cutter's left output into the required top half and trash the unused right half.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B84"]},"building":{"kind":"rotater"}},"why":"C1 left output is a half shape; rotating it in place yields the goal orientation."},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B85"]},"building":{"kind":"trash"}},"why":"C1's other output must not back up the cutter, so replace it with a trash."}]}

{"say":"Nothing reaches the hub yet; the two ore runs merging into L3 still carry uncut shapes, so convert them in place to cutter+trash so only the wanted half-shape flows onward toward the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B112","B105","B97","B90","B81","B69","B63"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"cut the M3 ore run and discard the unwanted half before it reaches L3"},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B106","B98","B91","B82","B70","B64"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"cut the parallel ore run feeding the same L3 merger"}]}
